Method.description: Method starting with its first test, more tests follow it, then the implementation

Run.description: Run method logging to the console, has logger belongs to the members at the top

for.description: Loop over a list, Range or number, value and index are the current element

then else.description: Single line conditional, like condition ? value : other

has.description: Member, leave out the type when the name says it: has number, has logger

constant.description: Constant member or variable, computed only from constants

mutable.description: Variable that really changes, like a loop counter

let.description: Variable that does not change, calculated once

New type.description: New type named like its file: a member and a method starting with its first test
